status_vocabulary.candidate: Potential semantic mapping, but requires a specific profile and a conformance test.
status_vocabulary.conditional: Mapping depends on identity scheme, event class, time/quantity semantics or other explicit conditions.
status_vocabulary.not_direct: No direct equivalent; retain as Mycelix extension/provenance or a separately typed record.
status_vocabulary.unknown: Not inspected or not established by current evidence; do not infer support.

mappings.transformation: Use only if the checkpoint ID is globally unique, stable, and serialized as an EPCIS-compatible URI/identifier under a pinned profile.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: A local database ID or UUID string may not satisfy the chosen event identity profile; do not silently generate a new eventID without preserving the source identifier.
mappings.verification_rule: Round-trip exact event identity; reject duplicate IDs in a scope where the profile prohibits them.

mappings.transformation: Use epcList only for properly identified instances; use quantityList only for class-level quantity semantics with a governed identifier and unit.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: A SKU, product family, GTIN, serialized instance and local product row are not interchangeable.
mappings.verification_rule: Require an explicit identifier scheme and identity granularity; reject ambiguous product identifiers.

mappings.target_term: profile-specific lot/batch identifier using applicable EPCIS identifier or extension semantics
mappings.transformation: Map only through a reviewed identifier profile; retain original batch ID and namespace.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: No generic string field should be assumed to be an EPCIS lot identifier; the correct representation depends on object class/instance and ILMD or extension policy.
mappings.verification_rule: Validate against the exact GS1 identifier syntax and profile; unknown schemes remain unsupported.

mappings.transformation: Map only after resolving display text to a governed location identifier, such as a GS1 GLN or an explicitly governed URI.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: A human-readable location label is not a stable, globally governed location identity.
mappings.verification_rule: Require a stable location identifier; preserve display label separately.

mappings.target_term: profile-specific geospatial extension or location master-data reference
mappings.transformation: Preserve coordinates, coordinate reference system, accuracy and observation provenance in a declared extension/profile; link separately to readPoint/bizLocation.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: Latitude/longitude alone omit CRS, accuracy, source and semantics; they do not replace location identity.
mappings.verification_rule: Reject missing/unknown CRS for precision-critical cases; test coordinate order, axis convention and accuracy.

mappings.target_term: sourceList/destinationList or business transaction party references; separately authenticated VC issuer/subject/holder roles
mappings.transformation: Do not map DID to a party or credential role until actor, organization, issuer, subject, holder, resource owner and delegated authority are disambiguated.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: Identity string alone does not prove key control, organizational affiliation, role, authority or event observation.
mappings.verification_rule: Verify credential/proof, status/revocation and authority at event time; never infer authority from a reputation score.

mappings.transformation: Select ObjectEvent, TransformationEvent or AggregationEvent based on the physical business occurrence; map action/bizStep/disposition independently.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: The native values received/processed/shipped/delivered/inspected do not encode event class, process semantics, condition/state or business disposition.
mappings.verification_rule: Require domain-qualified event mapping and positive/negative controls for each supported action.

mappings.transformation: Normalize an exact instant to RFC3339 eventTime only when the source clock basis and units are known; retain eventTimeZoneOffset where required and record independent recordTime.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: A JavaScript millisecond epoch example does not carry source time zone, clock synchronization, uncertainty, or record-time semantics.
mappings.verification_rule: Reject ambiguous units, invalid offsets and impossible ordering; overlapping uncertain event intervals remain unordered.

mappings.target_term: sensorElementList subset where semantically applicable; external evidence artifact and VC evidence/proof references
mappings.transformation: Map only calibrated sensor observations to EPCIS sensor structures; retain photos, signatures, inspection reports and third-party attestations as content-addressed external evidence with explicit media/issuer metadata.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: An arbitrary evidence map or type label is not a calibrated observation, signed attestation or cryptographic proof.
mappings.verification_rule: Do not accept the boolean verified field as proof; verify signature, provenance, calibration and trust source independently.

mappings.target_term: native provenance link / NIST cryptographic linkage; no direct generic EPCIS predecessor field assumed
mappings.transformation: Retain as an explicit provenance graph edge with typed relationship and content-addressed predecessor reference; expose EPCIS-compatible event identifiers separately.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: Treating a private predecessor pointer as an EPCIS event property would invent semantics and may lose forks, multiple parents or corrections.
mappings.verification_rule: Verify referenced node, content digest, edge authority and graph completeness; detect cycles and equivocation.

mappings.transformation: Project only explicitly typed, issuer-scoped claims into credentialSubject; preserve epistemic levels and supporting evidence as separate typed references.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: Mycelix epistemic/normative/materiality classifications are not automatically W3C VC semantics.
mappings.verification_rule: Verify subject binding, issuer, securing mechanism, validity and status independently of claim truth.

mappings.transformation: Retain only as a producer assertion or derived verifier result with an explicit origin; never serialize it as if it were a proof.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: Self-asserted boolean can be mistaken for independent verification.
mappings.verification_rule: A consuming verifier must independently check the underlying evidence and must not trust the boolean alone.

mappings.transformation: Keep as an explicitly versioned internal diagnostic only; publish underlying checks and reason codes separately.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: A single score can conceal missing, stale or contradictory evidence and cannot stand in for a transparency receipt.
mappings.verification_rule: No critical invalid signature, revoked key, broken link or missing evidence may be compensated by the score.

mappings.transformation: Use an authenticated issuer identifier and profile-appropriate securing mechanism; keep issuer distinct from event actor, subject and holder.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: A DID string alone does not prove issuer key control, authorization or credential validity.
mappings.verification_rule: Verify proof, verification method, validity period and credential status under pinned trust policy.

mappings.target_term: validFrom / validUntil and credential status mechanisms
mappings.transformation: Credential validity bounds must remain separate from EPCIS event occurrence time and event record time.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: Credential validity does not mean the underlying event occurred within the same interval or was true.
mappings.verification_rule: Check validity and status at the relevant decision/event time; unknown status is not valid.

mappings.target_term: signed statement with transparency service receipt
mappings.transformation: Bind a canonical statement subject to a transparency-service receipt under the selected RFC 9943 / SCITT profile.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: A Mycelix DHT claim ID, local hash chain, VC signature or eventID does not by itself prove inclusion in an independent transparency service.
mappings.verification_rule: Independently verify statement signature, receipt/proof, service identity and consistency under the chosen profile.

mappings.target_term: encapsulation, linkage, query and selective disclosure principles
mappings.transformation: Map existing event and evidence structures to the framework principles; document gaps and participant exchange boundaries.
mappings.semantic_loss_risk: A diagram or local hash link is not evidence that parties can independently query and verify a continuous cross-organizational chain.
mappings.verification_rule: Test with independent implementations and independent organizations; preserve unknown/withheld information as unknown rather than absence.

benchmark_requirements: same event content round-trips through at least two independent implementations
raw source identity and source digest remain available
unsupported semantic fields never disappear silently
event time and record time remain distinct
selective disclosure is tested for utility, leakage and correlation
signature, VC status and SCITT transparency receipt are separately verified
non_claims: No standards conformance has been tested by this mapping.
No production security or issuer-key custody guarantee is established.
No product authenticity or physical truth is established by a signature alone.
No SCITT API or receipt profile draft is treated as a final RFC.
No Mycelix checkpoint field is assumed equivalent solely by name.
